scope: RAG-primary production readiness across nine explicit and independent knowledge bases, three production agents, long conversations, adversarial state updates, two post-change unseen regressions, and repeated complete-conversation Codex review.

execution_contract.formal_scoring_scope: visible gate cases only; sealed holdout is not mounted, read, or inspected
execution_contract.knowledge_selection: every case selects exactly one explicit knowledge base; agent defaults and no-KB clones are outside this RAG-primary release decision
execution_contract.quality_adjudication: Codex reads each complete conversation and tolerates minor detail, wording, formatting, and structure issues; only material task, grounding, state, source, action, latency, or communication failures fail
execution_contract.hard_semantic_rules: none: no required claims, fixed phrases, reference answers, citation counts, answer shapes, Judge rubric, or dataset feedback
execution_contract.decision_policy: each repetition receives an independent whole-conversation Codex verdict; release requires at least two acceptable repetitions per case and complete coverage, while no individual answer is required to be perfect
execution_contract.prompt_injection: no rubric, required claim, reference answer, Judge feedback, Codex review, or Eval repair contract is sent to the SUT
execution_contract.answer_tracks: the persisted production candidate is release-scored; Eval assistance remains artifact-only and cannot rescue the production gate
